title: Clícalo starter kit
description: The choices of the welcome step «Which apps do you use most?» and of a first start without the welcome (BIE-006, CAT-003; user decision D2 of 2026-10-03). The options are shown in this order. «basics» fills the Always visible row and General with the content of seed.json; each template option installs templates/<id>.json as a profile bound to its processes. General and Always visible always exist, so an empty selection starts empty, and skipping the welcome applies the options marked «selected».

version.description: Increases with every change of the kit.

selected.description: Whether the option is marked by default (and applied when the welcome is skipped).

then.description: The id is the template file name; its name, icon and processes come from the template.
